The illustration supports a mid-century modern masonry building, three visible window levels, flat roof, horizontal floor bands, covered entry, and tall sign wall with AΦ/Alpha Phi lettering. It is unscaled; no dimensions taken.

measurements.after_wall_base: All 16 transformed GIS ring vertices matched the reopened base with 0.0 m maximum residual.
measurements.position_status: Wall ring follows the source map feature point-for-point; source accuracy is unpublished.

geometry_edits: Rebuilt the massing object as a single detailed mesh with the exact 16-point official GIS base outline.
Added three main facade levels, repeated vertical glazing bays, floor bands and light masonry surfaces following the exact-house artist illustration.
Added the flat roof cap, raised end sign wall, readable AΦ and Alpha Phi sign, centered covered entry, posts and steps.
Removed unused original image datablocks so the saved library contains no external image dependencies.
Preserved the assigned asset path, ID, collection, object name, campus coordinate frame, and identity object transform.
uncertainties: Campus GIS is not a certified survey and publishes no positional accuracy, vertical datum, or meanings for NUM_LEVELS/Extrution.
The three-story interpretation is based on an unscaled artist drawing; the GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 attribute conflicts and has no documented convention.
Eaves/sign wall heights, exact facade rhythm, material finish, sign-wall dimensions, and entry bearing remain estimated or unverified.
The artist illustration is not dated or georeferenced, and current conditions may differ from it. No measured floor plan or elevation was found.

independent_grade.summary: Exact GIS footprint, yearbook identity/address, and modular export pass. Three-level facade and raised sign-wall heights are estimated; facade bearing is unregistered and GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with visual evidence.
